english.title: Importer of electrical equipment presenting risk fail to inform market surveillance authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an importer of electrical equipment, which presented a risk, failed to immediately inform the market surveillance authority and the national authorities of any other member State in which the manufacturer made the electrical equipment available on the market, of the risk, giving details of the respect in which the electrical equipment was considered not to be in conformity with Part 2 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 and any corrective measures taken
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(2), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Three years see Regulation 54 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016
